verses.text: Ha winhaj Absalón yuninal winhaj rey David, ay jun ix yanab' winh skuch Tamar, te wach' yilji ix. Haxo ix aji, a winhaj Amnón yuninal pax winhaj rey David chi', ix te kan snib'ej winh t'a ix Tamar schab'il yanab', yuj chi' ix te chukb'i sk'ol winh yuj sna'ub'tanhan ix. Te ayoch yilumal ix yujto kob'esto ix, yuj chi' ix sna winhaj Amnón chi' to ajaltak sk'uman ix winh.
Palta ay jun winh yamigo winh skuchan Jonadab, yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj David chi', te jelan winh t'a chukal.

Ay jun k'u ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Amnón chi': --Ach yuninal rey, ¿tas tzach ik'ani? ¿Tas yuj junjun k'u tzach te tz'onb'i yuj kusk'olal? Al t'ayin tas tzach ik'ani, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Amnón chi': --Ste kan wal in gana t'a ix Tamar, yanab' winh schab'il wuk'tak aj Absalón, xchi winh.

Haxo ix yalan winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, ek'anh jichan t'a a ch'at, tza tz'akan pena'ayax a b'a. Ayik ol jawok winh a mam ach yila', tzal t'a winh icha tik: Tzin tewi t'ayach to tza chekkot ix Tamar ix wanab', yik syak' jab'ok in wa'el ix, a'okab' ix sb'o'ani, yik wach' ol wila', ol in wa'ani, ol in cha'an t'a ix, xa chi t'a winh, xchi winh.

Ix ek' jichan winhaj Amnón chi' t'a sch'at, ix stz'akan pena'ayax sb'a winh. Ayik ix k'och winh rey chi' yil winh, ix yal winh icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to skot ix wanab' Tamar t'a tik, sb'o'an chab'ok in pan ix, tzul yak'ankan ix t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix chekjib'at ix yuj winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ixik t'a spat winhaj Amnón a nulej, b'at a b'o'an jab'ok tas swa winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at ix Tamar t'a spat winh snulej chi', haxo ix k'och ix, jichan ek' winh. K'elanoch winh t'a ix, ix sb'o'an ixim pan chi' ix.

Ix yak'an k'anb'ok ixim ix t'a yol xalten, ix yik'anelta ix t'a yol xalten chi', palta haxo winhaj Amnón chi' maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix wa'i, ix yalan winh: Elanhek t'a tik he masanil, xchi winh. Ix elta heb', manhxalaj junok mach ix kani.

Ayik toxo ix elta heb' chi' smasanil t'a patik pat chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix Tamar chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot in wa'el chi' b'aj tzin way tik, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yik'anb'at ixim pan chi' ix t'a winh snulej chi' t'a sch'at.
Haxo yik ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winh yet' swa'el chi', ix och lak'naj winh t'a ix, ix yalan winh: --Kotanh ach wanab', wayanh wet'ok, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --Ma'ay ach in nulej, manh in ak' pural, yujto a jun tik manh smojok yuji t'a ko kal a onh israel onh tik, te k'ixwelal ol aj jun tik.

Nato nab'i ¿tas ol in k'ulej yuj jun in k'ixwelal tik? Hanhejtona' a ach tik icha junok kistal ol ach ajkan t'a skal ko chonhab' tik. Ha tikne'ik, swal t'ayach to tzal t'a winh rey, a winh ol in ak'an t'ayach etb'eyumok, xchi ix.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal ix chi'. Yujto te ay yip winh t'a yichanh ix, yuj chi' ix yak'an pural ix winh yixtani.

Ayik ix lajwi yixtan ix winh, te chuklaj ix aj yilanoch ix winh, t'a yichanh ix aj skan snib'ej winh t'a ix t'a sb'ab'elal, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a ix icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an, elanh t'a tik t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh t'a ix.
Palta ix tak'wi ix: --Ma'ay ach in nulej, tato tzin a pechel t'a tik tikne'ik, yelxo te chuk t'a yichanh tas ix in utej tik, xchi ix. Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh.
Haxo ix aji, ix yawtankot winh schekab' winh, ix yalan winh: --Pechel jun ix ix tik t'a tik, wach' tzutej a makan te' pat chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix pechji'elta ix yuj winh schekab' winh chi', wach' ix yutej winh smakan sti' te' pat chi'. Ha ix Tamar chi', ayoch jun spichul ix te wach' yuj, haton syak'och heb' ix kob'estak yisil rey.
Ix yak'ank'e k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh ix t'a sjolom, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul ix ayoch yuj, ix yak'anoch sk'ab' ix t'a sat, te cha'anh ix ok' ix sb'at t'a yoltak b'e.

Ix sk'anb'an winh snulej ix skuchan Absalón t'ay: --¿Tom ach yixtej winh a nulej aj Amnón chi'? Tato icha chi' ach wanab', emanh numan b'ela. Mokab' ach te ok' yuj ilk'olal yuj jun chi', yujto a nulej winh, xchi winh t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix kan ix t'a spat winh snulej chi'. Te kusk'olal ix ajkan ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David masanil tas ix uji chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il.
Haxo winhaj Absalón chi', malaj tas ix yal winh t'a winhaj Amnón chi', wach'chom ste chichon sk'ol winh t'a winh yuj b'aj ix ixtaj ix yanab' chi'.

Schab'ilxo ab'il chi', a heb' winh schekab' winhaj Absalón chi', sjoxwi kalnel heb' winh t'a Baal-hazor, t'a slak'anil schonhab' heb' aj Efraín. Ix yawtan masanil heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi' winhaj Absalón chi' t'a jun niwan wa'el.

Ix b'at yalan winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a tikne'ik a heb' winh in chekab' wan sjoxan nok' in kalnel heb' winh. Tzin nib'ej, tzach b'at wet'ok yet' masanil heb' etyajalil, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay ach wuninal, max yal-laj ko b'at ko masanil het'ok. Tekan niwan tas b'at ko lajeli, xchi winh. Ix och wal te'an winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix b'ati, anhej wach' lolonel ix yal winh t'a winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Absalón chi': --Tato wal yel max yal-laj a b'ati, elokab' t'a a k'ol a cha'anb'at winh wuk'tak aj Amnón wet'ok, xchi winh. --¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej sb'at winh uk'tak aj Amnón chi' het'ok? xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a winh.
Ix och wal te'an winhaj Absalón chi' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix schekb'at winhaj Amnón chi' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yuk'tak.

Ayik mantzak ochlaj wa'el chi', ix yalan winhaj Absalón chi' t'a heb' winh schekab': Scham wal heyilani ayik toxo ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winhaj Amnón chi', ol walan t'ayex to tze milcham winh. Manh ex xiwok, yujto a in swala', yuj chi' tze tek'b'ej he b'a he milancham winh, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix yal winh, ix smilcham winhaj Amnón chi' heb' winh. Ayik ix yilan masanil heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi', ix k'e somnaj heb' winh, ix laj k'e heb' winh t'a yib'anh nok' smula, ix b'at heb' winh elelal.
Ayik ayto och heb' winh t'a yol b'e, ix k'och spekal t'a winhaj rey David to toxo ix cham masanil heb' yuninal winh yuj winhaj Absalón, manhxo junok heb' winh ixto kani.

Yuj chi' ix k'e juknaj winh, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh, ix sjulanek' telan sb'a winh t'a sat lu'um yuj kusk'olal. Haxo masanil heb' yetyajalil winh ayek' yet'ok, ix snhik'chitejpaxb'at spichul heb'.

Palta a winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Simea, yuk'tak winhaj rey David chi', ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, manh a na' icha chi'. Maj chamlaj heb' winh uninal chi' smasanil, anhej winhaj Amnón ix chami, yujto icha chi' ix aj sna'an winhaj Absalón t'a spatik winh, yiktax ix yixtan ix Tamar winh.
Yuj chi' manh a na' to masanil heb' winh uninal ix chami, palta anhej winhaj Amnón ix chami, xchi winh.

Yakb'an chi' ix b'at winhaj Absalón chi' elelal. Ay jun winh kelem ayk'e t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab' chi' yik smaklani, ix k'e k'elnaj winh, ix yilan winh to ay juntzanh anima tz'emta t'a pak'an t'a sat witz t'a sb'e'al Horonaim, yuj chi' ix yalb'at winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Jonadab t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, wan sjawi heb' winh uninal icha ix aj walan a in a chekab' in tik, xchi winh.
Hato wal slajwi yalan winhaj Jonadab chi' ix k'och heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh, ix k'e sjaj heb' winh yok'i, ix te ok'pax winh rey chi' yet' heb' yetyajalil.

Haxo winhaj Absalón chi', ix b'atkan winh elelal. Ha t'a winhaj Talmai yuninal winhaj Amiud sreyal Gesur ix k'ochkan winh. Oxe' ab'il ix kan winh ta'. Haxo pax winhaj rey David chi', junjun k'u ix ok' winh yuj schamel winh yuninal.
Ayik toxo ix ek'b'at skusk'olal winh chi' jun, snib'ej winh sb'at yil winhaj Absalón chi'.
